ops.text: Shared cargo target dir (/Users/yasyf/.cargo/shared-target) collides across concurrent v14 lane worktrees: a sibling lane's build clobbered the cc-transcript-core dev-profile artifact, so maturin develop in the p2-smallmods worktree LINKED A STALE CORE (missing that lane's own pub/module changes) even though its source was correct — the same silent-staleness class as the uv wheel cache, one layer down. Workaround that worked: per-worktree CARGO_TARGET_DIR for extension builds. Any parallel-lane setup building pyo3 extensions needs isolated target dirs or a quiescent window; freshness canaries (assert new symbols exist) catch it after the fact.
